name.description: Name shown in the Runs panel.

kind.description: script runs a shell command, smart runs a prompt in headless Claude Code.

command.description: Shell command of a script. Not for a smart run.

prompt.description: Prompt of a smart run. Not for a script.

collection.description: Group name in the Runs panel. Omit for no group.

dir.description: kira runs in a folder Kira keeps for this run, fixed runs in path.

path.description: Absolute folder to run in. Only with dir fixed.

use_ade_dir.description: Run in the task's branch worktree when started from an ADE task.

params.description: Inputs of the run. A command reads KIRA_PARAM_<NAME>, a prompt reads {name}.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and _, starting with a letter.

options.description: Choices of a select or multiselect.

default.description: Default value, one string or a list of strings.

secret.description: Text only. The value is never in a file: set it in Kira.

smart.description: Settings of a smart run. Only with kind smart.

max_budget_usd.description: Cost cap in USD. 0 or absent takes the default.

tools.description: Claude tools the run may use. Absent takes Read, Grep, Glob.

bash_patterns.description: Bash command patterns the run may use. Needs the Bash tool.

mcp.description: MCP servers the run may use.

server.description: Name of an MCP server defined in agent settings.

all_tools.description: Allow every tool of the server.

tools.description: Allowed tools when all_tools is off.

schedule.description: Run on a schedule while the app is open.

cron.description: Five cron fields: minute hour day month weekday.

timeout.description: Duration limit of a script run, like 30m. Not for a smart run.
